leftEvidence.title: The tent is raised amid rebuilt cities, harvest, and planting in the land

points.label: Surrounding movement
points.left: Restoration includes Edom, nations, fields, cities, vineyards, and secure planting.
points.right: The quotation follows Gentile testimony and supports a proposed communal judgment.

points.label: Wording and use
points.left: The prophecy announces what the LORD will do in that day.
points.right: James says prophetic words agree with what the assembly has heard.

payload.posture: Hold both complete sources together while preserving each speaker, setting, sequence, and canonical voice.

rightEvidence.title: James quotes the rebuilt tent while addressing Gentile inclusion

payload.tension: The later speech cites the tent within a new argumentative setting without erasing Amos’s broader restoration picture.
payload.title: David’s fallen tent in Amos and Acts
